content_sections.heading: TISS Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download TISS notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Master's degree from a recognised university in Social Work, Psychology, Counselling, Education, Adult Education, Lifelong Learning or a related discipline Experience: Desirable: experience in research methods and documentation; designing and facilitating training/workshops; organising seminars or conferences; developing academic materials; working in counselling, mental health, adult learning or continuing education. Other conditions: Only for Mumbai-based candidates; candidates from Mumbai or nearby areas need to apply. Desirable: Experience in research methods and documentation. Experience in designing and facilitating training/workshops. Experience in organising seminars or conferences and developing academic materials. Experience in counselling, mental health, adult learning or continuing education. Strong writing, coordination and digital skills.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Nine (09) months on a contractual basis. Part-time: 3 days per week.

content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications Online interview (tentative: 2nd week of December 2026) Only shortlisted candidates will be notified of the online interview. TISS reserves all rights of shortlisting and selection and will not communicate reasons.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Updated current CV Brief statement (maximum 300 words) describing relevant research and training experience

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TISS Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Prepare an updated current CV. Prepare a brief statement (maximum 300 words) describing relevant research and training experience. Email both to [email protected] by 30 November (Monday), 06:00 PM. Write the subject line: Application – Part-Time Training and Research Officer, PGDC-CLL 2026. Email it on or before 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Tentative date of online interview: 2nd week of December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Training & Research Officer (Part-time).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 30 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 25,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree from a recognised university in Social Work, Psychology, Counselling, Education, Adult Education, Lifelong Learning or a related discipline.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only for Mumbai-based candidates; candidates from Mumbai or nearby areas need to apply.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications. Online interview (tentative: 2nd week of December 2026). Only shortlisted candidates will be notified of the online interview. TISS reserves all rights of shortlisting and selection and will not communicate reasons.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Nine (09) months on a contractual basis. Part-time: 3 days per week.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Mumbai.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Updated current CV; Brief statement (maximum 300 words) describing relevant research and training experience.
